brief: A living-room corner people want to sit in: warm, calm, one clear focal point, modern and desirable (think a Scandinavian furniture catalogue hero shot).

judge.reason: Sterile beige low-poly render is calm and centered but looks crude, empty and uninviting with no message or desirability.

diagnosis: Reward/value areas (OFC/vmPFC) are low: no 'I want this' signal
Object-shape (LO) and motion (MT) areas are low: a text-first screen with no clear object silhouette
Attention drops after the first 2 s (+0.86 → +0.67): nothing to look at after the first impression
directives: Make the benefit concrete and desirable: show the outcome (before/after, real numbers, price or scarcity), warm highlight color on the offer, social proof near the CTA.
Add one dominant object silhouette (product shape, device frame, bold geometric hero) or a diagonal that implies motion.
Add a second discovery after the hero (a detail reveal, micro-illustration, or a strong secondary block) so interest holds past 2 s.
